rca of the issue: Prior script used window.location.href to navigate to each recipient's message thread, which destroyed the JS context after the first send. Current fix rewrites the client script to call LinkedIn Voyager APIs (identity/profiles + messaging/conversations?action=create) via fetch(), with CSRF extracted from the JSESSIONID cookie. No navigation is needed and script continues iterating through all recipients with 3-6s jitter. Verified structurally (backend tests + frontend clipboard). Note: recipient URN transformation on line ~1364 is a no-op and likely needs real logic before end-to-end sending will work on LinkedIn.
